{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Rebuild OID Maps
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      maps_enabled:
        type: boolean
        description: 'Update maps (slow)'
        required: false
        default:  true
      debug_enabled:
        type: boolean
        description: 'With build debug'
        required: false
        default:  false
#  push:
#    branches:
#      - master
jobs:
  update_maps:
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.maps_enabled }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          lfs: true

      - name: Cache Perl dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/perl5
            ~/.cpanm
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-perl-deps-${{ hashFiles('.github/workflows/update_maps.yml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-perl-deps-

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt install cpanminus
          cpanm File::Slurper

      - name: genxlate
        run: |
          cpanm --local-lib=~/perl5 local::lib && eval $(perl -I ~/perl5/lib/perl5/ -Mlocal::lib)
          export MIBHOME=`pwd`
          mkdir -p $MIBHOME/EXTRAS/indexes/cert_indexes
          EXTRAS/scripts/genxlate

      - name: mkoidmap
        run: |
          cpanm --local-lib=~/perl5 local::lib && eval $(perl -I ~/perl5/lib/perl5/ -Mlocal::lib)
          export MIBHOME=`pwd`
          mkdir -p $MIBHOME/EXTRAS/indexes/cert_indexes
          EXTRAS/scripts/mkoidmap

      - name: mkproductlookup
        run: |
          export MIBHOME=`pwd`
          grep -E '^\.1\.3\.6\.1\.4\.1\.[0-9]+\.' $MIBHOME/EXTRAS/reports/*_oids | \
            cut -s -d, -f1,2 | \
            sed -e 's/::/,/' | \
            cut -d : -f 2 | \
            cut -d , -f 1,3 | \
            grep -v '.0,' | \
            sed -e 's/^\.1\.3\.6\.1\.4\.1\.//' > $MIBHOME/EXTRAS/reports/all_leafs_only

      - name: Commit files
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git config --local user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git add --all
          git diff --staged --quiet || git commit -m "Update the OID maps via Github Actions"

      - name: Push changes
        uses: ad-m/github-push-action@master
        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && ! inputs.debug_enabled }}
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branch: ${{ github.ref }}

#    - name: Setup tmate session
#      uses: mxschmitt/action-tmate@v3
##      if: always() && github.event.inputs.debug_enabled
#      if: always() && ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.debug_enabled }}
##      with:
##        sudo: true

  build_object_sql:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: ${{ always() }}
    needs: update_maps
    container:
      image: 'netdisco/netdisco:latest-backend'
      options: '--user root --entrypoint /bin/ash'
      #volumes:
      #  - '/home/runner/work:/github/workspace'
      #  # this allows us to load in the new netdisco-mibs
      #  # /home/runner/work/netdisco-mibs/netdisco-mibs contains the files

    # PostgreSQL service container for temporary table
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:18
        env:
          POSTGRES_DB: netdisco
          POSTGRES_USER: netdisco
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: netdisco
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5

    steps:
      - name: Install packages
        run: |
          apk update
          apk add --no-cache git git-lfs openssh-client nodejs curl gzip sudo

      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          lfs: true
          # Include the commit pushed by update_maps.
          ref: ${{ github.ref }}

      - name: Deploy database schema
        env:
          NETDISCO_HOME: /__w/netdisco-mibs
          NETDISCO_DB_USER: netdisco
          NETDISCO_DB_PASS: netdisco
          NETDISCO_DB_HOST: postgres
          NETDISCO_DB_PORT: 5432
          NETDISCO_DB_NAME: netdisco
        run: |
          /home/netdisco/bin/localenv /home/netdisco/bin/netdisco-db-deploy

      - name: Parse current OID reports into SNMP objects
        env:
          NETDISCO_HOME: /__w/netdisco-mibs
          NETDISCO_DB_USER: netdisco
          NETDISCO_DB_PASS: netdisco
          NETDISCO_DB_HOST: postgres
          NETDISCO_DB_PORT: 5432
          NETDISCO_DB_NAME: netdisco
        run: |
          mkdir -p /__w/netdisco-mibs/environments
          echo 'loadmibs_timeout: 6000' >> /__w/netdisco-mibs/environments/deployment.yml
          /home/netdisco/bin/localenv /home/netdisco/bin/netdisco-do loadmibsfromoids --debug

      - name: Dump the data
        run: |
          mkdir -p /__w/netdisco-mibs/netdisco-mibs/EXTRAS/sql
          echo 'DELETE FROM "snmp_object";' >> /__w/netdisco-mibs/netdisco-mibs/EXTRAS/sql/netdisco-mibs-snmp-object.sql
          echo 'COPY snmp_object (oid, oid_parts, mib, leaf, "type", "access", "index", num_children, status, enum, descr) FROM stdin;' >> /__w/netdisco-mibs/netdisco-mibs/EXTRAS/sql/netdisco-mibs-snmp-object.sql
          sudo PGPASSWORD=netdisco psql -h postgres -U netdisco -d netdisco  -c "\copy snmp_object TO '/__w/netdisco-mibs/netdisco-mibs/EXTRAS/sql/netdisco-mibs-snmp-object.sql.new'"
          # Netdisco runs this file's DELETE unconditionally, so an empty or
          # truncated dump would wipe snmp_object on every install.
          SQLDIR=/__w/netdisco-mibs/netdisco-mibs/EXTRAS/sql
          NEW_ROWS=$(wc -l < $SQLDIR/netdisco-mibs-snmp-object.sql.new)
          OLD_ROWS=0
          if gzip -t $SQLDIR/netdisco-mibs-snmp-object.sql.gz 2>/dev/null; then
            OLD_ROWS=$(( $(gzip -dc $SQLDIR/netdisco-mibs-snmp-object.sql.gz | wc -l) - 3 ))
          fi
          echo "snmp_object rows: $NEW_ROWS, previously committed: $OLD_ROWS"
          if [ "$NEW_ROWS" -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "::error::loadmibsfromoids produced no snmp_object rows; check that EXTRAS/reports/*_oids are real files and not git-lfs pointers. Refusing to commit SQL that would empty snmp_object."
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ $(( NEW_ROWS * 10 )) -lt $(( OLD_ROWS * 9 )) ]; then
            echo "::error::snmp_object shrank by more than 10% ($OLD_ROWS -> $NEW_ROWS rows); check the loadmibsfromoids output above. If the drop is intended, lower this threshold in the same commit as the change that causes it."
            exit 1
          fi
          cat /__w/netdisco-mibs/netdisco-mibs/EXTRAS/sql/netdisco-mibs-snmp-object.sql.new >> /__w/netdisco-mibs/netdisco-mibs/EXTRAS/sql/netdisco-mibs-snmp-object.sql
          rm /__w/netdisco-mibs/netdisco-mibs/EXTRAS/sql/netdisco-mibs-snmp-object.sql.new
          echo '\.' >> /__w/netdisco-mibs/netdisco-mibs/EXTRAS/sql/netdisco-mibs-snmp-object.sql
          rm -f /__w/netdisco-mibs/netdisco-mibs/EXTRAS/sql/netdisco-mibs-snmp-object.sql.gz
          gzip -9 /__w/netdisco-mibs/netdisco-mibs/EXTRAS/sql/netdisco-mibs-snmp-object.sql

      - name: Commit files
        run: |
          git config --global --add safe.directory /__w/netdisco-mibs/netdisco-mibs
          git config --local user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git config --local user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git add /__w/netdisco-mibs/netdisco-mibs/EXTRAS/sql/netdisco-mibs-snmp-object.sql.gz
          git diff --staged --quiet || git commit -m "Update SNMP Objects SQL"

      - name: Push changes
        uses: ad-m/github-push-action@master
        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && ! inputs.debug_enabled }}
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branch: ${{ github.ref }}

      - name: Setup tmate session
        uses: mxschmitt/action-tmate@v3.24
        if: always() && inputs.debug_enabled
        env:
          NETDISCO_HOME: /__w/netdisco-mibs
          NETDISCO_DB_USER: netdisco
          NETDISCO_DB_PASS: netdisco
          NETDISCO_DB_HOST: postgres
          NETDISCO_DB_PORT: 5432
          NETDISCO_DB_NAME: netdisco
          PGUSER:     netdisco
          PGPASSWORD: netdisco
          PGHOST:     postgres
          PGPORT:     5432
          PGDATABASE: netdisco
        with:
          sudo: true",
  "rationale": "The workflow repeatedly fetches dependencies on every run: update_maps installs cpanminus via apt and File::Slurper/local::lib via cpanm (local::lib is installed once per genxlate and mkoidmap step), and build_object_sql reinstalls apt packages in a fresh container each run. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (observational evidence; reported modest aggregate VM-time benefit) supports caching dependency download state while keeping all installation and required checks intact. No equivalent cache exists in the workflow, and the cached content is dependency download state rather than unchecked build outputs. I added a single actions/cache@v4 step to update_maps that caches the Perl local::lib and cpanm download state, keyed on the OS plus the workflow file (which declares the install commands), with restore-keys for fallback. All jobs, steps, conditions, permissions, and build/test coverage are preserved; no new secrets, privileged actions, deployment operations, or network access are introduced.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}

```yaml
name: Rebuild OID Maps
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      maps_enabled:
        type: boolean
        description: 'Update maps (slow)'
        required: false
        default:  true
      debug_enabled:
        type: boolean
        description: 'With build debug'
        required: false
        default:  false
#  push:
#    branches:
#      - master
jobs:
  update_maps:
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.maps_enabled }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          lfs: true

      - name: Cache Perl dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/perl5
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-perl-deps-${{ hashFiles('.github/workflows/update_maps.yml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-perl-deps-

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt install cpanminus
          cpanm File::Slurper

      - name: genxlate
        run: |
          cpanm --local-lib=~/perl5 local::lib && eval $(perl -I ~/perl5/lib/perl5/ -Mlocal::lib)
          export MIBHOME=`pwd`
          mkdir -p $MIBHOME/EXTRAS/indexes/cert_indexes
          EXTRAS/scripts/genxlate

      - name: mkoidmap
        run: |
          cpanm --local-lib=~/perl5 local::lib && eval $(perl -I ~/perl5/lib/perl5/ -Mlocal::lib)
          export MIBHOME=`pwd`
          mkdir -p $MIBHOME/EXTRAS/indexes/cert_indexes
          EXTRAS/scripts/mkoidmap

      - name: mkproductlookup
        run: |
          export MIBHOME=`pwd`
          grep -E '^\.1\.3\.6\.1\.4\.1\.[0-9]+\.' $MIBHOME/EXTRAS/reports/*_oids | \
            cut -s -d, -f1,2 | \
            sed -e 's/::/,/' | \
            cut -d : -f 2 | \
            cut -d , -f 1,3 | \
            grep -v '.0,' | \
            sed -e 's/^\.1\.3\.6\.1\.4\.1\.//' > $MIBHOME/EXTRAS/reports/all_leafs_only

      - name: Commit files
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git config --local user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git add --all
          git diff --staged --quiet || git commit -m "Update the OID maps via Github Actions"

      - name: Push changes
        uses: ad-m/github-push-action@master
        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && ! inputs.debug_enabled }}
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branch: ${{ github.ref }}

  build_object_sql:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: ${{ always() }}
    needs: update_maps
    container:
      image: 'netdisco/netdisco:latest-backend'
      options: '--user root --entrypoint /bin/ash'
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:18
        env:
          POSTGRES_DB: netdisco
          POSTGRES_USER: netdisco
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: netdisco
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
    steps:
      - name: Install packages
        run: |
          apk update
          apk add --no-cache git git-lfs openssh-client nodejs curl gzip sudo

      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          lfs: true
          ref: ${{ github.ref }}

      - name: Deploy database schema
        env:
          NETDISCO_HOME: /__w/netdisco-mibs
          NETDISCO_DB_USER: netdisco
          NETDISCO_DB_PASS: netdisco
          NETDISCO_DB_HOST: postgres
          NETDISCO_DB_PORT: 5432
          NETDISCO_DB_NAME: netdisco
        run: |
          /home/netdisco/bin/localenv /home/netdisco/bin/netdisco-db-deploy

      - name: Parse current OID reports into SNMP objects
        env:
          NETDISCO_HOME: /__w/netdisco-mibs
          NETDISCO_DB_USER: netdisco
          NETDISCO_DB_PASS: netdisco
          NETDISCO_DB_HOST: postgres
          NETDISCO_DB_HOST: postgres
          NETDISCO_DB_PORT: 5432
          NETDISCO_DB_NAME: netdisco
        run: |
          mkdir -p /__w/netdisco-mibs/environments
          echo 'loadmibs_timeout: 6000' >> /__w/netdisco-mibs/environments/deployment.yml
          /home/netdisco/bin/localenv /home/netdisco/bin/netdisco-do loadmibsfromoids --debug

      - name: Dump the data
        run: |
          mkdir -p /__w/netdisco-mibs/netdisco-mibs/EXTRAS/sql
          echo 'DELETE FROM "snmp_object";' >> /__w/netdisco-mibs/netdisco-mibs/EXTRAS/sql/netdisco-mibs-snmp-object.sql
          echo 'COPY snmp_object (oid, oid_parts, mib, leaf, "type", "access", "index", num_children, status, enum, descr) FROM stdin;' >> /__w/netdisco-mibs/netdisco-mibs/EXTRAS/sql/netdisco-mibs-snmp-object.sql
          sudo PGPASSWORD=netdisco psql -h postgres -U netdisco -d netdisco  -c "\copy snmp_object TO '/__w/netdisco-mibs/netdisco-mibs/EXTRAS/sql/netdisco-mibs-snmp-object.sql.new'"
          SQLDIR=/__w/netdisco-mibs/netdisco-mibs/EXTRAS/sql
          NEW_ROWS=$(wc -l < $SQLDIR/netdisco-mibs-snmp-object.sql.new)
          OLD_ROWS=0
          if gzip -t $SQLDIR/netdisco-mibs-snmp-object.sql.gz 2>/dev/null; then
            OLD_ROWS=$(( $(gzip -dc $SQLDIR/netdisco-mibs-snmp-object.sql.gz | wc -l) - 3 ))
          fi
          echo "snmp_object rows: $NEW_ROWS, previously committed: $OLD_ROWS"
          if [ "$NEW_ROWS" -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "::error::loadmibsfromoids produced no snmp_object rows; check that EXTRAS/reports/*_oids are real files and not git-lfs pointers. Refusing to commit SQL that would empty snmp_object."
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ $(( NEW_ROWS * 10 )) -lt $(( OLD_ROWS * 9 )) ]; then
            echo "::error::snmp_object shrank by more than 10% ($OLD_ROWS -> $NEW_ROWS rows); check the loadmibsfromoids output above. If the drop is intended, lower this threshold in the same commit as the change that causes it."
            exit 1
          fi
          cat /__w/netdisco-mibs/netdisco-mibs/EXTRAS/sql/netdisco-mibs-snmp-object.sql.new >> /__w/netdisco-mibs/netdisco-mibs/EXTRAS/sql/netdisco-mibs-snmp-object.sql
          rm /__w/netdisco-mibs/netdisco-mibs/EXTRAS/sql/netdisco-mibs-snmp-object.sql.new
          echo '\.' >> /__w/netdisco-mibs/netdisco-mibs/EXTRAS/sql/netdisco-mibs-snmp-object.sql
          rm -f /__w/netdisco-mibs/netdisco-mibs/EXTRAS/sql/netdisco-mibs-snmp-object.sql.gz
          gzip -9 /__w/netdisco-mibs/netdisco-mibs/EXTRAS/sql/netdisco-mibs-snmp-object.sql

      - name: Commit files
        run: |
          git config --global --add safe.directory /__w/netdisco-mibs/netdisco-mibs
          git config --local user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git config --local user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git add /__w/netdisco-mibs/netdisco-mibs/EXTRAS/sql/netdisco-mibs-snmp-object.sql.gz
          git diff --staged --quiet || git commit -m "Update SNMP Objects SQL"

      - name: Push changes
        uses: ad-m/github-push-action@master
        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && ! inputs.debug_enabled }}
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branch: ${{ github.ref }}

      - name: Setup tmate session
        uses: mxschmitt/action-tmate@v3.24
        if: always() && inputs.debug_enabled
        env:
          NETDISCO_HOME: /__w/netdisco-mibs
          NETDISCO_DB_USER: netdisco
          NETDISCO_DB_PASS: netdisco
          NETDISCO_DB_HOST: postgres
          NETDISCO_DB_PORT: 5432
          NETDISCO_DB_NAME: netdisco
          PGUSER:     netdisco
          PGPASSWORD: netdisco
          PGHOST:     postgres
          PGPORT:     5432
          PGDATABASE: netdisco
        with:
          sudo: true
```
